definitions.explanation: Materials that are discarded as no longer useful or wanted, especially in industrial or environmental contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{産業|さんぎょう}→産業：01419_sangyou⟧{廃棄物|はいきぶつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{処理|しょり}→処理：03251_shori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: The disposal of industrial waste is a problem.

examples.japanese: {廃棄物|はいきぶつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{減|へ}らす→減らす：02414_herasu⟧⟦ために→ために：28332_tameni⟧⟦リサイクル→リサイクル：04624_risaikuru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{進|すす}める→進める：01949_susumeru⟧。
examples.english: We promote recycling to reduce waste.

examples.japanese: ⟦{核|かく}→核：13127_kaku⟧{廃棄物|はいきぶつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{保管|ほかん}→保管：11442_hokan⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}している→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: They are looking for a storage location for nuclear waste.

notes:
{廃棄物|はいきぶつ} is a formal/technical term for waste, commonly used in official and environmental contexts.

FORMS:
⟦{廃棄|はいき}→廃棄：12482_haiki⟧ (disposal, scrapping) + ⟦{物|ぶつ}→〜物：28336_butsu⟧ (thing) = {廃棄物|はいきぶつ}

TYPES OF WASTE:
- ⟦{産業|さんぎょう}→産業：01419_sangyou⟧{廃棄物|はいきぶつ} - industrial waste
- ⟦{一般|いっぱん}→一般：01737_ippan⟧{廃棄物|はいきぶつ} - general waste (household)
- ⟦{核|かく}→核：13127_kaku⟧/⟦{放射性|ほうしゃせい}→放射性：28219_houshasei⟧{廃棄物|はいきぶつ} - nuclear/radioactive waste
- ⟦{有害|ゆうがい}→有害：13002_yuugai⟧{廃棄物|はいきぶつ} - hazardous waste

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {廃棄物|はいきぶつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{処理|しょり}→処理：03251_shori⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ - to dispose of waste
- {廃棄物|はいきぶつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{削減|さくげん}→削減：11789_sakugen⟧ - waste reduction

{廃棄物|はいきぶつ} VS ⟦ゴミ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧:
{廃棄物|はいきぶつ} is the formal/legal term, while ⟦ゴミ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧ is the everyday word for garbage/trash.
